changelog: 1.1: every file now uses a passes array; fixture 05 verdict corrected to reject; DUPLICATE_ROW_EXACT standardised to info; resolution added to every blocking defect; as_of_date fixed for deterministic DATE_FUTURE tests

1.2: descriptive series findings removed from validation. Validation gates whether a run may proceed; quality characterises the history. DATE_FUTURE was removed from fixture 11 because every date precedes the fixed 2026-08-01 as_of_date.

contract.principle: Never coerce silently. Every transformation is reported. Ambiguity is escalated to the user, not resolved by guessing.
contract.resolution_rule: Every blocking defect names the decision the user supplies to unblock it. A blocking defect with no resolution path is a design defect, except where the file genuinely cannot be used.

verdicts.accept: No blocking and no warning findings. Information findings may be present.
verdicts.accept_with_warnings: Proceed, but every finding is shown before the run and carried into the report.
verdicts.reject: Do not run. Explain the problem, name the rows, and offer the resolution.

passes_model.description: Validation is a guided conversation. A structural block stops the pipeline, the user supplies the missing decision, and a new pass runs with those options recorded.
passes_model.test_rule: Assert the verdict and the expected codes per pass, not across the file as a whole.
